The first term is $-0.25$ and the common ratio is $8$.

| $\footnotesize\maroonC{\times 8\,\Large\curvearrowright}$ | | $\footnotesize\maroonC{\times 8\,\Large\curvearrowright}$ | | $\footnotesize\maroonC{\times 8\,\Large\curvearrowright}$ | |
:-: |  :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-:
$-0.25,$ | | $-2,$ | | $-16,$ | | $-128,...$

This is the recursive formula of $-0.25\,,-2\,,-16\,,-128,...$.

$\begin{cases}
b(1)=-0.25
\\\\
b(n)=b(n-1)\cdot 8
\end{cases}$
